chapters.title: Land diving
text: On Pentecost island, men dive from tall wooden towers with vines tied to their ankles, a harvest ritual called Nagol that inspired bungee jumping. Sand drawing is on UNESCO's list.

chapters.title: Food
text: Lap lap, grated root vegetables baked with coconut cream, is the national dish.

items.title: Water music
items.subtitle: Gaua
items.text: Women make music by slapping water.

items.name: Nagol season
items.text: Land diving from April to June.
